datasets.title: IGAD Region - Monthly Combined Drought Indicator(CDI) 2023
datasets.description: Monthly Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) as implemented in the East Africa Drought Watch, and which is used for detecting and monitoring areas that either are affected or have the potential to be affected by meteorological, agricultural and/or hydrological drought.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/igad-region-monthly-combined-drought-indicator-cdi-2023]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: Monthly CDI raster grids were generated by ICPAC using the East Africa Drought Watch methodology, which combines multiple drought indicators to detect and monitor meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought conditions across the IGAD region. The dataset comprises 12 monthly GeoTIFF files covering all months of 2023, providing temporal drought hazard monitoring for early warning and risk assessment purposes.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: East Africa Drought Watch Combined Drought Indicator methodology that integrates meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought detection and monitoring across the IGAD region
